verses.html: 15 Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are what defile him.”

verses.html: 18 “Are you still so dull?” He asked. “Do you not understand? Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him,

verses.html: 19 because it does not enter his heart, but it goes into the stomach and then is eliminated.” (Thus all foods are clean.)

verses.html: 15 Whatever people eat cannot make them unclean. Rather, it is what people do and say that makes them unclean.

verses.html: 17 Later, Jesus went into a house {with his apprentices}, away from the large group of people. Then, the apprentices asked him to explain the example {he had given}.

verses.html: 18 Jesus answered, “So, you too have not yet learned what I mean. You should know that whatever people eat cannot make them unclean.
verses.text: 18 Jesus answered, “So, you too have not yet learned what I mean. You should know that whatever people eat cannot make them unclean.

verses.html: 19 In fact, what people eat does not become part of what they think. Rather, it simply goes into their stomachs. Eventually, their bodies expel what they ate into toilets.” So, {Jesus was implying that} no food is unclean.
